Card Q&A.a: Yes, if a Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself yellow, the effect activates.
Card Q&A.q: If the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself yellow, does this card’s inherited effect activate?

Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] If you have a yellow Digimon in play, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) If you do, trash 1 card in your hand.
